component-o.pin_roles_note-s: pin roles: a fuse (and its holder) is non-polar; pin 1 = supply side (ds-power-rx) and pin 2 = load side (ds-power-tx) is a convention only, as on the DSK310 series diode; either orientation is electrically the same
component-o.supply_pins_are_pass_note-s: a fuse in the power path: its pins tagged ds-power-rx / ds-power-tx are the two ends of the fuse element, which have no operating supply range, current or ripple limit of their own; the fuse ratings in fuse-o (4 A, 250 VAC, 12.9 milliohm cold) are the figures the checks use
